get.description:
Nominal and real return of free-market USD, gold, coin and the one-year treasury yield
over the last ``months`` months, against inflation released by the as-of day (docs/07).

Every stock, fund and right that traded on the newest day: the bubble where a value is
known (fund NAV, right = base - nominal), and the adjusted return over the period against
inflation released by that day (docs/06).

Start the refill unless one is already running. The job is its own process; poll
``GET /data-health`` for ``refill.state``.

get.description:
Latest NAV per fund (fipiran) and, for listed units, the bubble against the close of
the same day (docs/06).

What each leveraged fund did against the market, from the PC's daily document
(``tmon.tools.leveraged_funds``). Empty until that tool has run.
The process is up. A deploy or a watchdog uses this one to see that it answers.
Export-domestic axis, dollar tie, beta and cohesion per industry (PC cycle artifact).
One card per industry: the consensus move of its symbols, breadth, value and money.
One industry: consensus candles of all its symbols and a row for each symbol.

Finds the instrument behind ``/instruments/<sector>/<symbol>``. The slugs are compared in
their normalised form, so Arabic letter forms and half-spaces in a typed address still match.
When two instruments share a symbol, the one in that industry wins, then one still listed,
then the newer.

Adjusted daily candles (never raw prices), the latest stored features, corporate events,
Codal letters, news and shareholders.

Hold for the AGM or sell before it (docs/05). DPS and timing come from the caller; the
price, the risk-free rate (default for r_m and r_alt) and the costs come from the database,
and every input says where it came from.

Recent days of the reduced order book and where the symbol stood among the stocks with a
stored book on the latest day. ``available=false`` for symbols outside the 100 most traded.

Is now a sensible moment and price to buy this symbol, and where and when to sell it?
Today's range comes from the exchange for this request (nothing kept); the answer weighs the
gap, the place in the day's range, the model's tested edge after cost, the history of days
that opened like today and the order book. It also carries the exit ladder (where to leave a
sell limit) and the best quarter-hours of the session to buy and to sell. With ``paid`` it
also grades a purchase made at that price today.

get.description: The pages answer fast: 503 while the start-up build of the derived columns still runs.

The living ranking: which method is champion per horizon after the gate, its weights against
equal weights, the weight drift, the cycle history and the replay on the past
(``python -m tmon.tools.adapt_cycle``). The past, not advice.

What the system saw when it last checked itself: the regime reading of the official index
and the events since (a champion changed, the regime flipped). Read fresh from the stored
document (``python -m tmon.tools.autopilot``). The past, not advice.

After a given candle, how often the next 1 to 20 candles were up, against every symbol
one could buy on the same days (``python -m tmon.tools.entry_odds``). The past, not advice.

What the order book and the buy/sell queues add to the score and what a realistic portfolio
(queue waits, 10% of the day's value, costs) earned in the tested history
(``python -m tmon.tools.orderbook_research``). The past, not advice.

The market-state plan run forward on paper: today's state from breadth, the action it
calls for, the decision log and the paper account against the basket and cash
(``python -m tmon.tools.regime_paper``). A test, not advice; no order is placed.

Every classic reading of the glossary's chart terms, tested on the whole TSETMC history
(``python -m tmon.tools.ta_signals``). A description of the past, not advice.

Recently traded right issues against their base stock: a right is worth the base close
minus the nominal price, so the bubble is (price - value) / value (docs/06).

Every symbol that traded on the latest stored day, with its market data, a few features
and the verdict of the v2 ranking. ``columns`` adds derived columns (``/columns/catalog``) to
each row; ``sort_col`` sorts by one of them before the limit is applied.

Latest ranking of the liquid basket written by ``python -m tmon.tools.v2_ranking``,
with the evidence per horizon and the gate verdicts. Not a recommendation unless
``recommendation_allowed`` is true.
